title: One-pot ligation protocol for Oxford Nanopore libraries
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k9acz2e

steps.title: Perform End-Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up either the standard end-prep reaction or the combined reaction including FFPE DNA repair.

steps.title: Perform Ligation
steps.instruction: Add the ligation reagents directly to the previous reaction and incubate at RT for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Clean Up with Ampure XP Beads
steps.instruction: Perform a bead-based cleanup of the library.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Spin down briefly and place on a magnetic rack until the solution clears.
Remove the supernatant, taking care to avoid the pellet.

steps.title: Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice using ABB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 μl ABB and resuspend by gently flicking (Wash 1).
Spin down briefly and place on a magnetic rack until the solution clears.
Remove the supernatant, taking care to avoid the pellet.
Add 150 μl ABB and resuspend by flicking (Wash 2).
Spin down briefly and place on a magnetic rack until the solution clears.
Remove the supernatant, taking care to avoid the pellet.

steps.title: Elute Library
steps.instruction: Remove residual wash buffer and elute the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Spin down again and remove all residual ABB with a P10 pipette.
Add 12 μl ELB and resuspend beads by flicking.
Spin down briefly and place on a magnetic rack until the solution clears.

steps.title: Prepare Library for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare the library dilution in a new tube, including LLB unless working with HMW DNA or planning to flush/reload the flowcell.

substeps.instruction: Remove 1 µl to assess concentration by Qubit (wait until beads have settled before measuring).
